verdict.rationale: Sales Cloud's pricing page lists "Built-in Sales Flows and Lead Routing" alongside lead management, so automatic lead routing is a first-party capability. However, the evidence is a single feature-list line with no detail on how routing works. Missing for 10: documentation of assignment rules or round-robin distribution specifically, configuration depth for routing criteria and owner matching, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can route new leads to the right owner automatically with assignment rules or round-robin
